name: Mr Agent
description: AI chat for CPN. Local LLM (Ollama/LM Studio/Bionic) is first-class. MCP skills = panel tools; provider API keys = cloud text. Optional floating bubble and owner storage/resource limits.
author: master3395
uninstall_impacts: Mr Agent app under the site plugins folder is removed
Floating bubble disappears from CPN Panel
Secrets under /var/lib/cpn/mr-agent/<domain>/ remain until cleaned manually

settings_fields.label: Public URL path (after install.sh)
Enable Mr Agent chat for this site
Show floating chat bubble in CPN Panel
Who can use chat: admins_only | all_authenticated | packages
Allowed package ids (comma list when visibility=packages)
Allow users to add their own provider API keys
Default provider: free | local | openai | anthropic | custom
Max chat messages per user per hour
Max characters per user message
Max tokens per model reply
Max concurrent chat requests per user (1 or 2)
Max stored messages per conversation
Max stored conversations (oldest pruned)
Auto-prune chat logs older than N days
Max chat log disk MB under /var/lib/cpn/mr-agent/
Local provider request timeout (seconds)
Local provider max response bytes
Max HTTP request body bytes (refuse huge uploads)
Operator notes (optional)
settings_fields.default: After Store install, run: sudo bash install.sh <domain>. Prune: php modules/cli_prune.php <domain>

settings_fields.label: Local OpenAI-compatible base URL (server; Ollama 11434, LM Studio 1235)
Local model name (e.g. llama3.2:1b)
Local-only mode (never call cloud providers)
Allow local LLM on private LAN IPs
